M01.description: Last bin is half-open: a point exactly at the final edge is dropped (and counted in n_dropped).

M02.description: Bins are left-open (e_k, e_k+1]: points on interior edges go to the lower bin and a point at e0 is dropped.

M03.description: Out-of-range points are clipped into the first or last bin instead of being dropped; n_dropped is always 0.

M04.description: n_dropped counts only points below the first edge; points above the last edge are excluded but not counted.

M06.description: Mean is the unweighted arithmetic mean of y in the bin; err still uses the inverse-variance weights.

M07.description: err is the scatter of y in the bin divided by sqrt(n) (zero for a single point) instead of (sum w)^-1/2.

M08.description: err = 1/sum(w): the square root is missing.

M09.description: x_eff is the bin midpoint instead of the weighted mean position.

M10.description: Empty bins return x_eff = mean = err = 0 instead of NaN.

M11.description: Points with non-finite y are silently dropped (not counted in n_dropped); x and sigma are still validated.

M12.description: sigma <= 0 is not rejected; sigma = 0 gives infinite weight (errors silenced).

M13.description: Unordered or decreasing edges are accepted and sorted internally instead of raising ValueError.

M14.description: Sorts the caller's x, y and sigma arrays in place (by x); results are unchanged but the inputs are modified.

M15.description: When y is float32 the weights and sums are accumulated in float32 instead of float64.

M16.description: Baseline: off-by-one bin index (every point lands in the next bin, the last wraps to the first); any reasonable suite kills it.
